name: What kind of damage can hidden mold cause to my home's structure?

mainEntity.name: What kind of damage can hidden mold cause to my home's structure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden mold behind walls can cause significant structural damage over time. As mold consumes organic materials like drywall, wood framing, and insulation, it weakens these components. This deterioration can lead to compromised wall integrity, sagging ceilings, and even structural instability if left untreated. Beyond the visible surfaces, mold can rot wooden studs, joists, and subflooring. Addressing hidden mold promptly is crucial to prevent extensive and costly repairs to your home's framework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden mold can weaken and rot structural components like drywall, wood framing, and insulation, leading to costly repairs.
